text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data, which may lead to wrong decisions about people. Fairness means that AI should treat everyone equally, without discrimination. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it responsibly. Transparency is another key idea: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means that governments, companies, and researchers must work together to create clear rules. They should test AI systems carefully and make sure they help society instead of causing harm.
